أرتزق (form VIII)
# أَرْتَزِقُ (ʔartaziqu) /ʔar.ta.zi.qu/: first-person singular non-past active indicative of اِرْتَزَقَ (irtazaqa)
# أَرْتَزِقَ (ʔartaziqa) /ʔar.ta.zi.qa/: first-person singular non-past active subjunctive of اِرْتَزَقَ (irtazaqa)
# أَرْتَزِقْ (ʔartaziq) /ʔar.ta.ziq/: first-person singular non-past active jussive of اِرْتَزَقَ (irtazaqa)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
